about: Sounds the user has chosen for the game. package.py copies exactly these into build/sfx/upload/ for upload, and records each file's sha256 the first time; after that, a render that no longer matches is refused, because the code that makes it has changed since the user approved it. To accept a deliberate change, bump `version` and clear `sha256`: Roblox cannot replace an uploaded sound, so a new render is a new asset.

sounds.name: BF_Fireball_Explosion
sounds.game_hook: VfxConfig.EFFECTS.impact_damage_t2. It currently uses SFX.impactDamage, which other spells share, so it gets its own SFX entry when wired.

sounds.name: BF_FrostNip_Cast
sounds.plays_when: Frost Nip (blue tier 1) is cast. Take B, blast: a cold rush into a clashing ice strike and crackle.
sounds.game_hook: VfxConfig.EFFECTS.cast_blue_t1. It currently uses SFX.cast, which every cast shares, so it gets its own SFX entry when wired.

sounds.name: BF_Burning_Loop
sounds.plays_when: Loops for as long as a target is burning (Inferno's burn). Take B, roaring: a 3 s seamless loop.
sounds.game_hook: None yet: the game has no way to play a looping sound. Needs the loop path (tier D) and a listener on the burning status (InfernoVfxController). Set Looped = true.

sounds.name: BF_Collect_Crack_Red
sounds.plays_when: A red letter block is popped: the block cracking apart.
sounds.game_hook: VfxConfig.EFFECTS.block_pop_red: its sound entry (now SFX.blockPop, shared by all four colours) becomes this file. Plays at the block for everyone; the popper hears it on the tap (BlockTapController).

sounds.name: BF_Collect_Stream
sounds.plays_when: A popped letter's mana is drawn into the player: the swirl, the spark ticks and the landing (0.4 s).
sounds.game_hook: collectStream.play, which has no sound yet: start this on the collector's HumanoidRootPart when the stream starts (on the server's confirmation). The landing is baked in at 0.4 s = collectStream.FLIGHT_SEC; if that changes, re-render and bump the version.
